_doc: C9 rendered-text sanity allowlist (f373). Every rule needs id, token, routes (regex), text (regex), class (intended|followup) and a reason. intended = by design and labelled on the page. followup = a known defect that needs a data refresh, capped by max (the count of hits at 390+1280 may fall, never rise). A hit matching no rule fails scripts/test_text_sanity.mjs.

textRules.text: ^UNKNOWN$|UNKNOWN now|cost per job is UNKNOWN right now
textRules.reason: lib/site-data/markStale.mjs (EV6) renders any Proof Wall row measured more than 30 days before the build as UNKNOWN with the last-measured date, and a row whose source reading is UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN. f382 re-exported proof.json and ledger.json from the 2026-11-10 kernel baseline, so every baseline-fed tile now shows a traced figure (cap 328 to 176). What is left is the efficiency-round data (lib/efficiency/efficiency.json, measured 2026-10-08: the cost-per-job headline, 7 charts, 10 stars) plus three baseline readings the baseline itself calls UNKNOWN (worker start tokens, spend today, suite wall). Those need a re-measured efficiency round, not a code change. WOULD-FLIP: F1 = 0 once that round is re-measured.
Sentences that state the honest-UNKNOWN method (we say UNKNOWN when a record cannot be read; claim-label legends). Four or more words, so a bare UNKNOWN value slot never matches this rule.

Labelled claim chip beside a visible 'Not measured yet' / status-state / label legend (data-claim-label or data-status-state attribute). Sectors: no sector figure has been measured; /status: no live uptime samples yet (page says so).
Prose explaining that a ratio with an empty denominator returns null; the word is the subject of the sentence.
